The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit.In the SSCG of Center Extender, in upper extension and lower extension side Precise Diagnosis mode of operation, while the influence minimum of the clock frequency that the noise for producing diagnostic circuit is exported to SSCG.The SSCG of the Center Extender modulating clock centered on the frequency for being multiplied by predetermined number and obtaining by input reference clock frequency is produced to be configured as the modulation circuit for including phase comparator, VCO and being formed by frequency divider and frequency dividing ratio modulation circuit.Frequency dividing ratio modulation circuit provides the frequency dividing ratio modulated in predetermined multiplier above and below to frequency divider, and exports the magnitude relation for being included as propagation direction id signal.Diagnostic circuit includes the counter counted to modulated clock, and performs counting operation in upper extension or lower expanded period based on propagation direction id signal.Based on the value counted for predetermined period, for example, the mode of operation of SSCG is diagnosed for presence or absence of failure.

Technical field

Present invention relates in general to the semiconductor integrated circuit with spread-spectrum clock generator (SSCG), and specifically, It is related to the self diagnosis of the semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

SSCG is the clock generator of the modulating clock frequency in the way of changing over time.SSCG is most of to be arranged on numeral LSI is upper as clock generator, for suppressing the unnecessary electromagnetic radiation from semiconductor integrated circuit.Usually, pass through Modulation circuit is added to reference clock it is transfused to and multiplies the PLL circuit of frequency wherein and again and configure SSCG.There are two kinds of extensions Modulation, Center Extender modulation and lower extension modulation, with respect to the centre frequency for being suitably multiplied by reference clock frequency acquisition. Center Extender modulation is comprising modulation symmetrically in the frequency of centre frequency above and below.Lower extension modulation is comprising only to lower frequency side On frequency be modulated, wherein highest frequency be by be suitably multiplied by reference clock frequency set up.

Meanwhile, the self-diagnostic function for semiconductor integrated circuit is important, because as its integrated level is continuously increased, Its testing cost is increasing.Especially, it is critically important, its replaceable other necessary spy for SSCG to possess self-diagnostic function Different equipment such as its time of measuring tends to the spectralyzer of extension.

Unexamined Japanese patent publication 2006-333119 (hereinafter referred to as patent document 1) discloses a kind of for surveying The circuit engineering of the clock generating circuit for making SSCG on probation.Disclosed technology extends the center modulated frequently comprising measurement for lower The rate and frequency of measurement to compare with standard value to diagnose the clock generating circuit be normal or defective.

In above-mentioned patent document 1 [0023rd] is as follows to the structure described in [0025] section and Fig. 1：The structure includes SSCG2 and the test circuit 1 being used therewith.SSCG2 utilizes common PLL modulating frequencies multiplication using the ripple signal of modulation The VCO control voltages of circuit.In a pll, phase comparator detects reference-input signal and uses frequency divider from VCO divided clocks Export the phase difference between the feedback signal for obtaining.The output of phase comparator is defeated by charge pump circuit and low pass filter Enter the control voltage terminal to VCO.When modulation is not performed, SSCG outputs are derived from being multiplied for the frequency multiplication of reference-input signal Frequency clock.Multiplication is counted to be counted by the division of frequency divider and is given.When modulation is performed, SSCG ripples of the output based on modulation The clock that signal fluctuates up and down on frequency its frequency for being multiplied.The ripple signal of modulation be low frequency signal such as triangular signal or Sing ripple signal and period of waves and fluctuation range are given to the clock frequency of SSCG.Test circuit is modulated by with comparator binaryzation Ripple signal produce indicate modulating wave a cycle data signal, and using produce data signal, obtain counter With the clock count of a cycle to modulating wave.Count value and the count value of a cycle of modulating wave that comparator will be measured Maximum compared with minimum value, so that it is determined that clock frequency whether fall on limit and lower limit in the middle of.

Unexamined Japanese patent publication 2007-78617 (hereinafter referred to as patent document 2) discloses a kind of for testing The circuit engineering of the SSCG on semiconductor chip such as ASIC.[0016th] of patent document 2 is to [0027] section and Fig. 1 Described in structure it is as follows：Counter A is provided to count non-modulated clock, and it is modulated to count to provide counter B Clock.The counting operation of counter A and B is started simultaneously at and writes reseting register by by reset instruction value.Hereafter, comparator is used Compared with the value of counter B in by the value of counter A.When the value of counter A reaches the predetermined counting set for register A During value, comparator exports stop signal to stop the counting operation of counter B.Signal is stopped in the counting operation of counter B After stopping, when modulation function is opened, the value of counter B is placed into register B, or is placed into when modulation function is closed In register C.In other words, including reset, a series of actions of counting operation, and count results transmission perform 2 times, i.e. when When modulation function is opened and when modulation function is closed.Hereafter, the value of the value of register B and register C is compared, and is compared Compared with result be output.In the case of lower extension modulation, if comparator detects the value of the value than register C of register B Small, SSCG is diagnosed as normally.

In the case where Center Extender is modulated, even if clock is by normal modulation, the register B in circuit outlined above Value becomes equal to the value of register C, because when closing is modulated, clock frequency is on centre frequency with the effect of vertical symmetry mode Fruit extends.Modulation operations are normal Activate or closing, and the value of register B is equal to the value of register C.This means above circuit It is normal or defective that SSCG can not be diagnosed.Therefore as patent document 2 Fig. 3 and [0033] to [0043] section described in, Using the test mode signal of the modulation operations of measurement half period, above bottleneck is bypassed.Test mode signal counts counter B The modulation operations of number half period, and in the clock count value of positive or negative modulation side is stored in register B.On the other hand, Modulation operations are closed, and the count value of a cycle is placed in register C.Comparator is by the half of the value of register C and deposits Whether the value of device B compares normal to diagnose SSCG.When the value of register B in the half period in positively-modulated side is more than register During the half of the value of C, and when the half of the value of the value less than register C of register B in the half period in negatively-modulated side, SSCG is diagnosed as normally.

The content of the invention

As pointed by patent document 2, during extension modulation instantly, circuit engineering is fully achieved described in patent document 1 Diagnostic function, but accurately diagnosis cannot be provided in the case where Center Extender is modulated.

Although patent document 2 indicates by the modulation operations of only half period count to avoid the inaccurate diagnosis of the above Bottleneck, but it does not disclose the method for producing the control signal counted for the modulation operations of half period.If adjusted The ripple signal of system is by accurate reverse signal such as sine wave, then to obtain the ratio of the ripple signal of binaryzation modulation in the half period Compared with the signal that device will have 50% dutycycle, i.e. accurate semiperiodic signal.But, test can limit the ripple letter of modulation Number waveform.

And, the ripple signal of modulation is the analog signal of modulation control voltage signal.When being superimposed with noise, the ripple of modulation Signal causes the frequency fluctuation of the clock of SSCG outputs.This means in order to test and testing results circuit can be by test circuit The noise of generation is added on the ripple signal of superposition, and the noise of superposition may cause the frequency fluctuation of the clock of SSCG outputs.This It is serious problem, because the feature of test object may be different because of test circuit.

The present invention is illustrated according to situation above and the semiconductor integrated circuit of innovation is provided.

When an implementation method of the invention realizes the present invention, there is provided a kind of SSCG, it produces a kind of modulated Clock, its frequency platform is modulated onto and is multiplied by the center that predetermined multiplication is counted and obtained by by the frequency of input reference clock Frequency above and below.SSCG includes：One phase comparator, it carries out the phase of reference clock with the phase of feedback clock The phase comparator for comparing；Oscillator, its modulated clock of output, its frequency of oscillation is based on the output from phase comparator And controlled；And modulation circuit, the input that it receives modulated clock is so as to output feedback signal.The modulation circuit includes Frequency divider and the frequency dividing ratio modulation circuit to frequency divider offer frequency dividing ratio, and by using frequency dividing ratio to the defeated of oscillator Go out to be divided to export feedback clock.Frequency dividing ratio modulating circuit modulates frequency dividing ratio so that ratio is over time in predetermined multiplication Above and below fluctuation is counted, while the output frequency dividing ratio and the multiplication count it in the form of propagation direction id signal Between magnitude relation.

The diagnostic circuit of SSCG includes the counter A counted to reference clock and modulated clock is counted Counter B.Based on propagation direction id signal, the counting operation of one or both of diagnostic circuit control counter A and B.Examine Deenergizing diagnoses the mode of operation of SSCG based on one of counter A and B or the value of the two (for example, presence or absence of scarce Fall into).

Above-mentioned implementation method of the invention etc. major advantage is as follows：

In the SSCG of Center Extender, can be in upper extension and lower extension side accurately diagnostic operation state, while making to examine The influence of the clock frequency that the noise produced by deenergizing is exported to SSCG is minimized.
